tools.name: piperun_list_deals
tools.description: List deals (oportunidades) with filters for pipeline, stage, person, company, owner, title and last update date. Returns one page and meta.cursor.next. GET /deals.

tools.name: piperun_get_deal
tools.description: Get one deal (oportunidade) by id, with its pipeline, stage, owner and value. GET /deals/{deal_id}.

tools.name: piperun_create_deal
tools.description: Create a deal (oportunidade) in a pipeline stage. Creates a new record in the CRM. POST /deals.

tools.name: piperun_update_deal
tools.description: Change fields of one deal (oportunidade): move it to another stage, rename it, change its value, owner, person, company or temperature. Only the fields you send change. PUT /deals/{deal_id}.

tools.name: piperun_list_persons
tools.description: List people (pessoas, contacts) with filters for name, company, job title and last update date. Returns one page and meta.cursor.next. GET /persons.

tools.name: piperun_get_person
tools.description: Get one person (pessoa) by id. GET /persons/{person_id}.

tools.name: piperun_create_person
tools.description: Create a person (pessoa, contact) with optional company and contact lists. Creates a new record. POST /persons.

tools.name: piperun_update_person
tools.description: Change the name, company or job title of one person (pessoa). Only the fields you send change. PUT /persons/{person_id}.

tools.name: piperun_list_companies
tools.description: List companies (empresas) with filters for name, CNPJ, segment, manager and last update date. GET /companies.

tools.name: piperun_get_company
tools.description: Get one company (empresa) by id. GET /companies/{id}.

tools.name: piperun_create_company
tools.description: Create a company (empresa). Creates a new record. POST /companies.

tools.name: piperun_list_activities
tools.description: List activities (atividades: tasks, calls, meetings) with filters for deal, owner, status and start date. Status: 0 open, 2 done, 4 no-show. GET /activities.

tools.name: piperun_get_activity
tools.description: Get one activity (atividade) by id. GET /activities/{id}.

tools.name: piperun_create_activity
tools.description: Create an activity (task, call or meeting) for a user, optionally linked to a deal. Status: 0 open, 2 done, 4 no-show. Creates a new record. POST /activities.

tools.name: piperun_list_pipelines
tools.description: List pipelines (funis) of the account. Use the ids in deal tools. GET /pipelines.

tools.name: piperun_list_stages
tools.description: List the stages (etapas de funil) of the account, optionally of one pipeline. GET /stages.

tools.name: piperun_list_items
tools.description: List products, services and recurring items (itens) with name, category and reference code. GET /items.

tools.name: piperun_list_notes
tools.description: List notes (notas) written on a deal, company or person. GET /notes.

tools.name: piperun_list_users
tools.description: List users (usuários) of the account, for example to find an owner id. GET /users.

tools.name: piperun_get_user
tools.description: Get one user (usuário) by id. GET /users/{user_id}.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "piperun_list_items" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: piperun_create_activity · Private data: piperun_create_deal, piperun_list_persons, piperun_create_person, piperun_create_company, piperun_create_activity · Public sink: piperun_create_deal, piperun_update_deal, piperun_create_person, piperun_update_person, piperun_create_company, piperun_create_activity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: piperun_create_activity · Private data: piperun_create_deal, piperun_list_persons, piperun_create_person, piperun_create_company, piperun_create_activity · Public sink: piperun_create_deal, piperun_update_deal, piperun_create_person, piperun_update_person, piperun_create_company, piperun_create_activity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
